model.olist_lakehouse.dim_customer.raw_code:

       s.customer_unique_id, s.zip_code_prefix, s.city, s.state_code, coalesce(g.geography_key, -1) as geography_key,
       s.effective_from, s.effective_to, s.is_current, s.version_no
from {{ source('silver', 'customer_address_scd2') }} s
left join {{ ref('dim_geography') }} g on g.zip_code_prefix = s.zip_code_prefix
union all
select -1, 'unknown', null, 'unknown', null, -1, date '1900-01-01', date '9999-12-31', true, 1

model.olist_lakehouse.dim_date.name: dim_date
model.olist_lakehouse.dim_date.raw_code:
{# the calendar of the warehouse (seed) + USD/BRL, IPCA index and official holidays of the API data (like dw.enrich_dim_date) #}
with hol as (
    select holiday_date, array_join(array_sort(array_agg(distinct name)), ' / ') as names from {{ source('silver', 'holiday_official') }} group by holiday_date
),
anyhol as (select count(*) as n from {{ source('silver', 'holiday_official') }})
select d.date_key, d.full_date, d.day_of_month, d.day_of_week, d.day_name, d.week_of_year, d.month, d.month_name, d.quarter, d.year, d.year_month, d.year_quarter,
       d.is_weekend, d.is_holiday_br, d.holiday_name, d.is_black_friday,
       f.usd_brl, i.ipca_index, case when (select n from anyhol) > 0 then h.holiday_date is not null end as is_holiday_official, h.names as holiday_name_official
from {{ ref('dim_date_base') }} d
left join {{ source('silver', 'fx_usd_brl') }} f on f.rate_date = d.full_date
left join {{ source('silver', 'ipca_month') }} i on i.month_date = date_trunc('month', d.full_date)
left join hol h on h.holiday_date = d.full_date
union all
select -1, null, null, null, 'Unknown', null, null, 'Unknown', null, null, 'Unknown', 'Unknown', null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null

model.olist_lakehouse.dim_geography.name: dim_geography
model.olist_lakehouse.dim_geography.raw_code:
{# zips of geolocation, customers and sellers (like dw.load_dim_geography) enriched with the IBGE municipality, microregion, mesoregion and population (P9) #}
with cs as (
    select zip, city, st, count(*) as n from (
        select zip_code_prefix as zip, city, state_code as st from {{ source('silver', 'customers') }}
        union all select zip_code_prefix, city, state_code from {{ source('silver', 'sellers') }}) u
    where zip is not null group by zip, city, st
),
city_mode as (
    select zip, city from (select zip, city, row_number() over (partition by zip order by n desc, city) as r
                           from (select zip, city, sum(n) as n from cs where city is not null group by zip, city)) where r = 1
),
st_mode as (
    select zip, st from (select zip, st, row_number() over (partition by zip order by n desc, st) as r
                         from (select zip, st, sum(n) as n from cs where st is not null group by zip, st)) where r = 1
),
other as (select z.zip, c.city, s.st from (select distinct zip from cs) z left join city_mode c on c.zip = z.zip left join st_mode s on s.zip = z.zip),
z as (
    select coalesce(g.zip_code_prefix, o.zip) as zip, coalesce(g.city, o.city) as city, coalesce(g.state_code, o.st) as st, g.latitude, g.longitude
    from {{ source('silver', 'geolocation_zip') }} g full join other o on o.zip = g.zip_code_prefix
),
x as (
    select z.*, r.state_name, r.region, m.ibge_code, i.microrregiao, i.mesorregiao, p16.population as p16, p17.population as p17, p18.population as p18,
           coalesce(m.method, 'unmatched') as match_method
    from z
    left join {{ ref('state_region') }} r on r.state_code = z.st
    left join {{ source('silver', 'city_ibge_match') }} m on m.state_code = z.st and m.city = z.city
    left join {{ source('silver', 'ibge_municipio') }} i on i.ibge_code = m.ibge_code
    left join {{ source('silver', 'ibge_population') }} p16 on p16.ibge_code = m.ibge_code and p16.year = 2016
    left join {{ source('silver', 'ibge_population') }} p17 on p17.ibge_code = m.ibge_code and p17.year = 2017
    left join {{ source('silver', 'ibge_population') }} p18 on p18.ibge_code = m.ibge_code and p18.year = 2018
)
select cast(row_number() over (order by zip) as integer) as geography_key, zip as zip_code_prefix, city, st as state_code,
       coalesce(state_name, 'Unknown') as state_name, coalesce(region, 'Unknown') as region, 'Brazil' as country, latitude, longitude,
       cast(ibge_code as integer) as ibge_municipio_code, microrregiao, mesorregiao,
       cast(p16 as integer) as populacao_2016, cast(p17 as integer) as populacao_2017, cast(p18 as integer) as populacao_2018, match_method
from x
union all
select -1, null, 'unknown', null, 'Unknown', 'Unknown', 'Brazil', null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null

model.olist_lakehouse.dim_seller.name: dim_seller
model.olist_lakehouse.dim_seller.raw_code:
{# conformed seller (sales + CRM); first_sale_date = first purchase date of an order that is not Failed, computed from Silver (no cycle with the fact) #}
with base as (
    select seller_id, zip_code_prefix as zip, city, state_code as st from {{ source('silver', 'sellers') }}
    union all
    select d.seller_id, cast(null as varchar), cast(null as varchar), cast(null as varchar)
    from {{ source('silver', 'closed_deals') }} d where not exists (select 1 from {{ source('silver', 'sellers') }} s where s.seller_id = d.seller_id)
),
fs as (
    select i.seller_id, min(cast(o.order_purchase_timestamp as date)) as first_sale_date
    from {{ source('silver', 'order_items') }} i
    join {{ source('silver', 'orders') }} o on o.order_id = i.order_id
    join {{ ref('order_status') }} os on os.order_status = o.order_status and os.status_group <> 'Failed'
    where cast(o.order_purchase_timestamp as date) between date '2016-01-01' and date '2020-12-31'
    group by i.seller_id
)
select cast(row_number() over (order by t.seller_id) as integer) as seller_key, t.seller_id, t.zip as zip_code_prefix, coalesce(t.city, 'unknown') as city, t.st as state_code,
       coalesce(g.geography_key, -1) as geography_key, d.mql_id is not null as is_from_funnel, d.mql_id,
       coalesce(m.origin, 'not_from_funnel') as acquisition_origin,
       case when d.mql_id is null then 'Not from funnel' else coalesce(og.channel_group, 'Unknown') end as acquisition_channel,
       d.business_segment, d.lead_type, d.business_type, cast(d.won_date as date) as won_date, fs.first_sale_date
from base t
left join {{ ref('dim_geography') }} g on g.zip_code_prefix = t.zip
left join {{ source('silver', 'closed_deals') }} d on d.seller_id = t.seller_id
left join {{ source('silver', 'mql') }} m on m.mql_id = d.mql_id
left join {{ ref('lead_origin_group') }} og on og.origin = m.origin
left join fs on fs.seller_id = t.seller_id
union all
select -1, 'unknown', null, 'unknown', null, -1, false, null, 'not_from_funnel', 'Not from funnel', null, null, null, null, null

model.olist_lakehouse.fact_lead_funnel.name: fact_lead_funnel
model.olist_lakehouse.fact_lead_funnel.raw_code:
{# accumulating snapshot, grain = MQL; recomputed completely (like dw.load_fact_lead_funnel) #}
with gmv90 as (
    select f.seller_key, sum(f.price) as gmv
    from {{ ref('fact_order_item') }} f
    join {{ ref('dim_seller') }} s on s.seller_key = f.seller_key and s.first_sale_date is not null and s.is_from_funnel
    join {{ ref('dim_date') }} dd on dd.date_key = f.purchase_date_key
    join {{ ref('dim_order_status') }} os on os.order_status_key = f.order_status_key and os.status_group <> 'Failed'
    where dd.full_date >= s.first_sale_date and dd.full_date < date_add('day', 90, s.first_sale_date)
    group by f.seller_key
),
t as (
    select m.mql_id, m.landing_page_id, {{ date_key('cast(m.first_contact_date as timestamp(6))') }} as first_contact_date_key,
           case when d.mql_id is null then -1 else {{ date_key(ts('d.won_date')) }} end as won_date_key,
           case when s.first_sale_date is null then -1 else {{ date_key('cast(s.first_sale_date as timestamp(6))') }} end as first_sale_date_key,
           coalesce(lo.lead_origin_key, -1) as lead_origin_key, coalesce(lp.lead_profile_key, -1) as lead_profile_key,
           coalesce(s.seller_key, -1) as seller_key, coalesce(sdr.sales_rep_key, -1) as sdr_key, coalesce(sr.sales_rep_key, -1) as sr_key,
           case when d.mql_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as is_won, case when s.first_sale_date is not null then 1 else 0 end as has_first_sale,
           date_diff('day', m.first_contact_date, cast(d.won_date as date)) as close_raw, date_diff('day', cast(d.won_date as date), s.first_sale_date) as sale_raw,
           d.declared_product_catalog_size, d.declared_monthly_revenue,
           case when s.first_sale_date is null then null else coalesce(g.gmv, 0) end as seller_gmv_first_90d
    from {{ source('silver', 'mql') }} m
    left join {{ ref('dim_lead_origin') }} lo on lo.origin = m.origin
    left join {{ source('silver', 'closed_deals') }} d on d.mql_id = m.mql_id
    left join {{ ref('dim_seller') }} s on s.seller_id = d.seller_id
    left join {{ ref('dim_lead_profile') }} lp on lp.business_segment = d.business_segment and lp.lead_type = d.lead_type
         and lp.lead_behaviour_profile = d.lead_behaviour_profile and lp.business_type = d.business_type
         and lp.has_company = d.has_company and lp.has_gtin = d.has_gtin and lp.average_stock = d.average_stock
    left join {{ ref('dim_sales_rep') }} sdr on sdr.rep_id = d.sdr_id and sdr.rep_role = 'SDR'
    left join {{ ref('dim_sales_rep') }} sr on sr.rep_id = d.sr_id and sr.rep_role = 'SR'
    left join gmv90 g on g.seller_key = s.seller_key
)
select mql_id, landing_page_id, first_contact_date_key, won_date_key, first_sale_date_key, lead_origin_key, lead_profile_key, seller_key, sdr_key, sr_key,
       is_won, has_first_sale, case when close_raw >= 0 then close_raw end as days_to_close, case when sale_raw >= 0 then sale_raw end as days_won_to_first_sale,
       declared_product_catalog_size, declared_monthly_revenue, seller_gmv_first_90d
from t

model.olist_lakehouse.fact_order_fulfill.name: fact_order_fulfillment
model.olist_lakehouse.fact_order_fulfill.raw_code:
{# accumulating snapshot, grain = order. Intervals come from the original timestamps; a negative value (source error) becomes NULL and is counted in
   dq_flag_count on top of the flags Silver already set. Hours and days are rounded in integer arithmetic (half away from zero, like PostgreSQL numeric). #}
with o as (
    select order_id, customer_id, order_status, dq_flag_count as ods_flags,
           {{ ts('order_purchase_timestamp') }} as purchase_ts, {{ ts('order_approved_at') }} as approved_ts, {{ ts('order_delivered_carrier_date') }} as carrier_ts,
           {{ ts('order_delivered_customer_date') }} as delivered_ts, {{ ts('order_estimated_delivery_date') }} as estimated_ts
    from {{ source('silver', 'orders') }}
),
it as (
    select order_id, count(*) as item_count, count(distinct seller_id) as seller_count, sum(price) as order_value, sum(freight_value) as freight_total
    from {{ source('silver', 'order_items') }} group by order_id
),
pm as (select order_id, sum(payment_value) as payment_total from {{ source('silver', 'order_payments') }} group by order_id),
base as (
    select o.order_id, o.order_status, o.ods_flags, o.purchase_ts, o.approved_ts, o.carrier_ts, o.delivered_ts, o.estimated_ts,
           coalesce(dc.customer_key, -1) as customer_key, coalesce(dc.geography_key, -1) as customer_geography_key, coalesce(os.order_status_key, -1) as order_status_key,
           {{ secs('o.purchase_ts', 'o.approved_ts') }} as approval_s, {{ secs('o.approved_ts', 'o.carrier_ts') }} as handling_s,
           {{ secs('o.carrier_ts', 'o.delivered_ts') }} as transit_s, {{ secs('o.purchase_ts', 'o.delivered_ts') }} as lead_s,
           date_diff('day', cast(o.estimated_ts as date), cast(o.delivered_ts as date)) as delay_days,
           date_diff('day', cast(o.purchase_ts as date), cast(o.estimated_ts as date)) as promised_raw,
           coalesce(it.item_count, 0) as item_count, coalesce(it.seller_count, 0) as seller_count, coalesce(it.order_value, 0) as order_value,
           coalesce(it.freight_total, 0) as freight_total, coalesce(pm.payment_total, 0) as payment_total
    from o
    join {{ source('silver', 'customers') }} c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    left join {{ ref('dim_customer') }} dc on dc.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id and cast(o.purchase_ts as date) between dc.effective_from and dc.effective_to
    left join {{ ref('dim_order_status') }} os on os.order_status = o.order_status
    left join it on it.order_id = o.order_id
    left join pm on pm.order_id = o.order_id
),
b2 as (
    select base.*, case when order_status = 'delivered' and delivered_ts is not null then 1 else 0 end as is_delivered,
           (case when approval_s < 0 then 1 else 0 end) + (case when handling_s < 0 then 1 else 0 end) + (case when transit_s < 0 then 1 else 0 end)
           + (case when lead_s < 0 then 1 else 0 end) + (case when promised_raw < 0 then 1 else 0 end) as neg_count
    from base
)
select order_id, customer_key, customer_geography_key, order_status_key,
       {{ date_key('purchase_ts') }} as purchase_date_key, {{ date_key('approved_ts') }} as approved_date_key, {{ date_key('carrier_ts') }} as carrier_date_key,
       {{ date_key('delivered_ts') }} as delivered_date_key, {{ date_key('estimated_ts') }} as estimated_date_key,
       purchase_ts, approved_ts, carrier_ts, delivered_ts, estimated_ts,
       case when approval_s >= 0 then {{ round2('approval_s', 3600) }} end as approval_hours,
       case when handling_s >= 0 then {{ round2('handling_s', 86400) }} end as handling_days,
       case when transit_s >= 0 then {{ round2('transit_s', 86400) }} end as transit_days,
       case when lead_s >= 0 then {{ round2('lead_s', 86400) }} end as lead_days,
       delay_days, case when promised_raw >= 0 then promised_raw end as promised_days,
       is_delivered, case when is_delivered = 1 and delay_days > 0 then 1 else 0 end as is_late, case when order_status = 'canceled' then 1 else 0 end as is_canceled,
       item_count, seller_count, order_value, freight_total, payment_total, ods_flags + neg_count as dq_flag_count
from b2

model.olist_lakehouse.fact_order_item.name: fact_order_item
model.olist_lakehouse.fact_order_item.raw_code:
{# transaction fact, grain = order item; same lookups and Unknown member (-1) as dw.load_fact_order_item #}
select i.order_id, i.order_item_id,
       {{ date_key(ts('o.order_purchase_timestamp')) }} as purchase_date_key,
       {{ date_key(ts('i.shipping_limit_date')) }} as shipping_limit_date_key,
       coalesce(dc.customer_key, -1) as customer_key, coalesce(dc.geography_key, -1) as customer_geography_key,
       coalesce(s.geography_key, -1) as seller_geography_key, coalesce(s.seller_key, -1) as seller_key,
       coalesce(p.product_key, -1) as product_key, coalesce(os.order_status_key, -1) as order_status_key,
       i.price, i.freight_value, i.price + i.freight_value as item_total
from {{ source('silver', 'order_items') }} i
join {{ source('silver', 'orders') }} o on o.order_id = i.order_id
join {{ source('silver', 'customers') }} c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id
left join {{ ref('dim_customer') }} dc on dc.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id
     and cast(o.order_purchase_timestamp as date) between dc.effective_from and dc.effective_to
left join {{ ref('dim_seller') }} s on s.seller_id = i.seller_id
left join {{ ref('dim_product') }} p on p.product_id = i.product_id
left join {{ ref('dim_order_status') }} os on os.order_status = o.order_status

model.olist_lakehouse.fact_review.name: fact_review
model.olist_lakehouse.fact_review.raw_code:
{# transaction fact, grain = (review, order); delivered_late comes from fact_order_fulfillment #}
select r.review_id, r.order_id,
       {{ date_key(ts('r.review_creation_date')) }} as review_creation_date_key, {{ date_key(ts('r.review_answer_timestamp')) }} as review_answer_date_key,
       coalesce(dc.customer_key, -1) as customer_key, cast(r.review_score as integer) as review_score,
       cast(r.review_score <= 2 as integer) as is_negative,
       cast(nullif(trim(r.review_comment_title), '') is not null as integer) as has_comment_title,
       cast(nullif(trim(r.review_comment_message), '') is not null as integer) as has_comment_message,
       coalesce(length(nullif(trim(r.review_comment_message), '')), 0) as comment_length,
       case when {{ secs(ts('r.review_creation_date'), ts('r.review_answer_timestamp')) }} >= 0
            then {{ round2(secs(ts('r.review_creation_date'), ts('r.review_answer_timestamp')), 3600) }} end as response_hours,
       coalesce(f.is_late, 0) as delivered_late, coalesce(f.is_delivered, 0) as is_delivered
from {{ source('silver', 'order_reviews') }} r
join {{ source('silver', 'orders') }} o on o.order_id = r.order_id
join {{ source('silver', 'customers') }} c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id
left join {{ ref('dim_customer') }} dc on dc.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id
     and cast(o.order_purchase_timestamp as date) between dc.effective_from and dc.effective_to
left join {{ ref('fact_order_fulfillment') }} f on f.order_id = r.order_id

model.olist_lakehouse.fact_seller_monthl.name: fact_seller_monthly
model.olist_lakehouse.fact_seller_monthl.raw_code:
{# periodic snapshot, grain = seller x month, dense grid from the first month with an item to the last month of the data #}
with it as (
    select f.seller_key, date_trunc('month', dd.full_date) as m, f.order_id, f.price, f.freight_value, os.status_group
    from {{ ref('fact_order_item') }} f
    join {{ ref('dim_date') }} dd on dd.date_key = f.purchase_date_key
    join {{ ref('dim_order_status') }} os on os.order_status_key = f.order_status_key
    where f.seller_key <> -1 and f.purchase_date_key <> -1
),
ord as (
    select i.seller_key, i.m, i.order_id, coalesce(max(fo.is_delivered), 0) as is_delivered, coalesce(max(fo.is_late), 0) as is_late, coalesce(max(fo.is_canceled), 0) as is_canceled
    from it i left join {{ ref('fact_order_fulfillment') }} fo on fo.order_id = i.order_id
    group by i.seller_key, i.m, i.order_id
),
sel as (select seller_key, min(m) as first_m from it group by seller_key),
lastm as (select max(m) as last_m from it),
grid as (select s.seller_key, g.m from sel s cross join lastm l cross join unnest(sequence(s.first_m, l.last_m, interval '1' month)) as g(m)),
a_it as (
    select seller_key, m, count(*) as items, sum(price) filter (where status_group <> 'Failed') as gmv, sum(freight_value) filter (where status_group <> 'Failed') as freight
    from it group by seller_key, m
),
a_ord as (
    select seller_key, m, count(*) as orders, sum(is_delivered) as delivered_orders, sum(is_late) as late_orders, sum(is_canceled) as canceled_orders
    from ord group by seller_key, m
),
a_rev as (
    select o.seller_key, o.m, avg(cast(r.review_score as decimal(10, 4))) as avg_score
    from ord o join {{ ref('fact_review') }} r on r.order_id = o.order_id group by o.seller_key, o.m
)
select cast(date_format(g.m, '%Y%m%d') as integer) as month_date_key, g.seller_key,
       cast(coalesce(ao.orders, 0) as integer) as orders, cast(coalesce(ai.items, 0) as integer) as items, coalesce(ai.gmv, 0) as gmv, coalesce(ai.freight, 0) as freight,
       cast(coalesce(ao.delivered_orders, 0) as integer) as delivered_orders, cast(coalesce(ao.late_orders, 0) as integer) as late_orders,
       case when ao.delivered_orders > 0 then round(cast(ao.late_orders as decimal(18, 4)) / ao.delivered_orders, 4) end as late_rate,
       cast(coalesce(ao.canceled_orders, 0) as integer) as canceled_orders, round(ar.avg_score, 2) as avg_review_score,
       case when coalesce(ao.orders, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as is_active,
       case when ds.first_sale_date is not null then cast((year(g.m) - year(ds.first_sale_date)) * 12 + month(g.m) - month(ds.first_sale_date) as integer) end as months_since_first_sale
from grid g
join {{ ref('dim_seller') }} ds on ds.seller_key = g.seller_key
left join a_it ai on ai.seller_key = g.seller_key and ai.m = g.m
left join a_ord ao on ao.seller_key = g.seller_key and ao.m = g.m
left join a_rev ar on ar.seller_key = g.seller_key and ar.m = g.m

### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
